This page structures 12 high-signal entries across user-facing behavior, security, compatibility, and developer APIs. It is a selective index of the preserved state, not a reproduction of Apple's complete list.

changes.title: AirPods adaptive listening beta features
changes.canonicalSummary: Apple exposed Adaptive Audio, Personalized Volume, and Conversation Awareness for testing through beta AirPods firmware.
changes.summary: The first retained state identifies three adaptive listening capabilities available to developers testing compatible AirPods firmware.
changes.verificationMethod: Present under AirPods — New Features with 110183983 in the first retained 161-record raw Apple DocC state after Beta 1 and before Beta 2; selected as representative, not exhaustive.

changes.title: Passkeys in third-party credential providers
changes.canonicalSummary: Credential-provider extensions gained system support for creating and offering passkeys.
changes.summary: Password managers can participate in passkey creation and sign-in through the expanded credential-provider API.
changes.verificationMethod: Present under Authentication Services and Passkeys — New Features with 83501802 in the first retained 161-record raw Apple DocC state after Beta 1 and before Beta 2; selected as representative, not exhaustive.

citations.locator: Authentication Services and Passkeys — New Features; issue 83501802

changes.title: Localized terms of address
changes.canonicalSummary: Foundation added term-of-address metadata for localized pronouns and grammatical agreement.
changes.summary: The initial snapshot adds a localization model for addressing people according to their preferred grammatical form.
changes.verificationMethod: Present under Foundation — New Features with 99745330 in the first retained 161-record raw Apple DocC state after Beta 1 and before Beta 2; selected as representative, not exhaustive.

changes.title: Resumable HTTP uploads
changes.canonicalSummary: URLSession added pausing and resuming for uploads when the server supports the relevant HTTP protocol.
changes.summary: Upload tasks gain download-like pause and resume behavior on compatible servers.
changes.verificationMethod: Present under Networking — New Features with 68890505 in the first retained 161-record raw Apple DocC state after Beta 1 and before Beta 2; selected as representative, not exhaustive.

changes.title: EAP-TLS 1.3 network authentication
changes.canonicalSummary: Apple devices added EAP-TLS 1.3 support for compatible 802.1X networks.
changes.summary: The documented network update brings the newer TLS profile and its stronger privacy and forward-secrecy properties to enterprise Wi-Fi authentication.
changes.verificationMethod: Present under Networking — New Features with 74526852 in the first retained 161-record raw Apple DocC state after Beta 1 and before Beta 2; selected as representative, not exhaustive.

changes.title: HEIC Photos editing output
changes.canonicalSummary: Photos editing extensions gained an API for HEIC-encoded rendered output.
changes.summary: A new content-editing output API lets extensions request a rendered HEIC destination.
changes.verificationMethod: Present under Photos — New Features with 109861295 in the first retained 161-record raw Apple DocC state after Beta 1 and before Beta 2; selected as representative, not exhaustive.

changes.title: PostScript and EPS conversion removal
changes.canonicalSummary: macOS removed several system paths that converted PostScript or EPS content to PDF or printable output.
changes.summary: The archived notes warn that Core Graphics, ImageIO, AppKit image representation, and printing workflows no longer provide the former conversion behavior.
changes.verificationMethod: Present under Printing — Deprecations with 110019863 in the first retained 161-record raw Apple DocC state after Beta 1 and before Beta 2; selected as representative, not exhaustive.

changes.title: StoreKit merchandising views
changes.canonicalSummary: StoreKit 2 added SwiftUI components for presenting products and subscriptions.
changes.summary: ProductView, StoreView, and SubscriptionStoreView reduce the custom interface work needed to merchandise in-app purchases.
changes.verificationMethod: Present under StoreKit — New Features with 102066107 in the first retained 161-record raw Apple DocC state after Beta 1 and before Beta 2; selected as representative, not exhaustive.

changes.title: Pie and donut charts
changes.canonicalSummary: Swift Charts added SectorMark for building pie and donut visualizations.
changes.summary: The initial macOS 14 state includes the angular mark type used for pie- and ring-shaped charts.
changes.verificationMethod: Present under Swift Charts — New Features with 102309263 in the first retained 161-record raw Apple DocC state after Beta 1 and before Beta 2; selected as representative, not exhaustive.

changes.title: Trusted Execution policy-check tool
changes.canonicalSummary: macOS added a command-line utility for evaluating an application against system trust policy.
changes.summary: Developers gain a local assessment tool covering notarization-adjacent and other macOS trust checks.
changes.verificationMethod: Present under Trusted Execution — New Features with 108737781 in the first retained 161-record raw Apple DocC state after Beta 1 and before Beta 2; selected as representative, not exhaustive.

changes.title: SwiftUI navigation bridging in AppKit hosts
changes.canonicalSummary: SwiftUI toolbar and navigation-title modifiers gained support outside the SwiftUI application lifecycle on macOS.
changes.summary: AppKit-hosted SwiftUI content can opt into scene bridging for toolbar and window-title integration.
changes.verificationMethod: Present under SwiftUI — New Features with 101092365 in the first retained 161-record raw Apple DocC state after Beta 1 and before Beta 2; selected as representative, not exhaustive.

changes.title: iPhone widget refresh after Mac wake
changes.canonicalSummary: The initial beta documented delayed refreshes for iPhone widgets displayed on a Mac after sleep.
changes.summary: A widget sourced from an iPhone might wait for its next scheduled update after the Mac wakes.
changes.verificationMethod: Present under iPhone Widgets on Mac — New Features with 109691143 in the first retained 161-record raw Apple DocC state after Beta 1 and before Beta 2; selected as representative, not exhaustive.
